newsitem.title: UK: Fenner to buy Scandura for $49 million.
newsitem.headline: Fenner to buy Scandura for $49 million.

text.p: UK power equipment manufacturer Fenner Plc said on Wednesday it was buying U.S. firm Scandura Holdings Inc for $49 million.
The company said in a statement it planned to finance the purchase through a placing of 9.28 million new ordinary Fenner shares at 145p per share to raise 13.5 million stg.
It will pay for the balance of the consideration via its own cash resources and bank facilities.
Fenner said that the acquisition would create the second largest heavy duty conveyer belt manufacturer in the world behind Goodyear.
It expects the purchase will enhance earnings per share in the first full year following completion.

Fenner said that trading was in line with expectations as it revealed that operating profit in the six months to February 28 had risen to 9.2 million stg from 8.5 million previously. It raised its interim dividend payment to 1.80p from 1.70p.
However, the firm warned that the strength of the pound and difficult markets in Europe mean that short term growth may be slower than in recent years.
